topic: What if you could dig a tunnel straight through the Earth? You would pass through the hot mantle and the iron core, hotter than the surface of the Sun.

episode.title: What If You Dug Straight Through Earth?

shots.narration: What if you dug a tunnel straight through Earth?
shots.scene: Colourful 3D science lab, vertical frame, glowing Earth hologram between Nova and Byte, no text.
shots.action: Nova traces a glowing tunnel straight through the Earth hologram.
shots.mood: Bright turquoise lighting, curious wide eyes, sparkling holographic glow.

shots.narration: First, you'd pass through the rocky crust and hot mantle.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with an enlarged cutaway Earth hologram, thin rocky exterior and thick orange mantle, no text.
shots.action: Nova guides a glowing marker from the crust into the mantle.
shots.mood: Warm orange light, vivid geological textures, fascinated expressions.

shots.narration: [surprised] Scientists think Earth's iron core exceeds the Sun's surface temperature.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a cutaway Earth hologram and a smaller Sun hologram, white-yellow inner core, no text.
shots.action: Nova magnifies the brilliant iron core beside the Sun hologram.
shots.mood: Dazzling golden glow, Byte's widened blue eyes, scientific wonder.

shots.narration: But immense heat and pressure would destroy a real tunnel.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a close-up holographic tunnel deep inside Earth's glowing interior, no people inside, no text.
shots.mood: Compressed orange rock, buckled tunnel walls, thoughtful expressions.

shots.narration: Gravity pulls you toward Earth's center.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a transparent Earth hologram surrounded by inward-pointing luminous arrows, no text.
shots.action: Nova draws the holographic arrows inward toward Earth's center.
shots.mood: Clear blue illumination, focused curiosity, crisp glowing geometry.

shots.narration: [excited] Imagine an ideal, heatproof, frictionless tunnel without air.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with an imaginary transparent tunnel crossing a cutaway Earth hologram, no text.
shots.action: Nova replaces the collapsed tunnel with a pristine glowing passage.
shots.mood: Playful violet glow, delighted expressions, clean luminous surfaces.

shots.narration: Falling through, you'd reach your greatest speed at the center.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a tall Earth cutaway hologram and a small luminous ball inside its ideal tunnel, no text.
shots.action: The holographic ball accelerates toward Earth's center.
shots.mood: Bright cyan motion trails, eager expressions, energetic scientific discovery.

shots.narration: Beyond the center, gravity slows you toward the opposite opening.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with the opposite half of the holographic Earth tunnel enlarged, no text.
shots.action: The luminous ball slows to a stop at the opposite opening.
shots.mood: Soft blue glow, shrinking motion trail, delighted anticipation.

shots.narration: [surprised] You'd oscillate—what if Earth stopped spinning?
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a stationary cutaway Earth hologram and its glowing ideal tunnel, no text.
shots.action: The luminous ball travels back and forth through Earth.
shots.mood: Playful blue and purple lighting, Nova's amazed smile, Byte's sparkling eyes.

episode.description: Dr. Nova shows Byte what lies beneath Earth's surface—and why a real tunnel through the planet wouldn't survive. Then an imaginary, ideal tunnel reveals a surprising gravity-powered journey.
